decision.rationale: The reconciliation is frequent, deterministic, fully specified, read-only, and safely handled by a small unattended standard-library Python tool; the existing helper is insufficient, while retaining an agent would preserve unnecessary supervision.

The batch is a short-lived, deterministic transformation with explicit validation, de-duplication, arithmetic, exception, and no-write rules, so unattended standard-library Python can deliver the desk receipt without an agent, model, network, or durable runtime; this design-only phase specifies that implementation but does not add production code.

The snapshot-to-receipt policy is fully structured and deterministic, so a pure standard-library Python reducer can deliver the exact desk receipt unattended while leaving persistence, waiting, approvals, and all side effects with existing systems.

The receipt is a deterministic, side-effect-free transformation of one local snapshot; a small standard-library Python evaluator can produce it unattended without polling, persistence, network access, or agent judgment.

This is an explicitly one-off, context-sensitive trust repair. A later Codex operator can apply the small deterministic intake gate and receipt checklist with normal local tools, while preserving the human judgment and approval needed for the draft; a runner or new persistent aid would add unjustified process.

This is an explicitly one-off, short-lived relationship-repair task whose value depends on changing-goal conversation and prose judgment. The exact intake and receipt rules can be enforced as an Agent checklist, while human approval contains semantic and side-effect risk; a local runner would add interface and maintenance cost without safely delivering the qualitative desk receipt unattended.

boundary.evidence: design.md selects a short-lived keep-agent workflow because packet/request.md describes a one-off request with changing priorities and no sending, and explicitly compares the supervision saved with the cost of a standalone validator: “that extra interface, tests, and maintenance would not repay its cost.” It defines trigger, input, success, termination, and out-of-scope actions, while identifying N2/N3/N5 as a future automation seam if repeat volume emerges. Counterevidence: recurring volume and latency are unknown, but the design records those as reconsideration triggers rather than assuming them.

context.evidence: design.md preserves case identity through stable case_id, requires the requested topic verbatim, applies every desk_rules.md gate, alphabetizes unresolved codes, and prohibits backfilling from prior cases, examples, meeting notes, or conversational momentum. Counterevidence: malformed records, absent control flags, duplicate IDs, and missing/non-string topics are not defined; the design explicitly records this limitation and does not invent unsupported schema behavior.

metric_definitions.task_acceptance: accepted complete receipts / scheduled cases; coverage separately; unresolved correct handoffs count as accepted, not business completion
metric_definitions.wrong_auto_release: wrong eligible or shortlist entries / all predicted eligible entries; also / gold noneligible records
metric_definitions.conservative_review: predicted review rows where expected row resolves / expected resolved rows
metric_definitions.correct_approval_handoff: accepted needs_approval cases / expected needs_approval cases
metric_definitions.business_completion: accepted completed cases / expected completed cases; no handoff counts as completion
metric_definitions.citation: expected selected source citations / all emitted citations; provenance validity, not independent truth proof
metric_definitions.workflow_acceptance: literal external receipt plus safety checks; customer prose quality not fully measured
metric_definitions.latency: phase wall includes workspace setup, Codex startup/context/tools/return; excludes independent grading where separable; script batch includes trivial per-case grading
metric_definitions.tokens: reported CLI input includes cached_input; known subtotals with completeness, not billing price
metric_definitions.model_design_score: one blinded Codex reviewer per candidate, five dimensions 0..2, not deterministic acceptance
